title: Random blood glucose

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Glucose is a type of sugar in the blood that the body uses for energy. A random blood glucose test measures glucose at any time of day, even after eating.
context: This test can be done right away without fasting, so a provider may use it first when checking for symptoms. Certain medicines can raise or lower glucose, so tell your provider what you take.
aboveRange: Can be associated with prediabetes or diabetes
May relate to an overactive thyroid, or a pancreas or adrenal gland condition
May follow stress from surgery, serious illness, or injury, or be linked to certain medicines
belowRange: In people with diabetes, may relate to certain diabetes medicines, eating too little, or more activity than usual
In people without diabetes, may relate to liver, kidney, adrenal, thyroid, or pituitary conditions, poor nutrition, some medicines, or alcohol use
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
